scope_boundary: C57 ports LingBot's complete persistent predicted/real observation-action K/V lifecycle into the five D0 ActionDiT blocks. It does not reproduce LingBot's official thirty shared world/action blocks. If C57 wins, fusion should preferentially place this lifecycle on C58b's thirty-layer layer-wise carrier.
hypothesis: Replacing D0's per-replan cold start with a training/deployment-identical rolling cache of real observations and executed actions improves paired Goal and LIBERO-10 success without materially degrading Object tasks.
single_variable: The candidate adds LingBot-style predicted-cache rollback plus persistent real observation/executed-action K/V across replans; D0-H32-s14000 weights, H3 checkpoint, layer49 carrier, action objective, action normalization, replan8 and evaluator remain fixed.

architecture.paper: Autoregressive joint video-action diffusion with shared causal blocks.
architecture.upstream_code: Thirty shared Wan2.2 blocks process noisy/clean video/action streams and are fully trainable.
architecture.local: Frozen INT8 H3 layer49 K/V is repeated into the five-block D0 ActionDiT, while persistent executed-action K/V is generated by those same five trainable blocks.
architecture.rationale: This is an H3/D0 backbone port, not an official Wan2.2 reproduction; the port preserves the actual cache state machine while retaining the proven D0 action parent.

architecture.paper: Predicted world/action cache is replaced by real feedback for autoregressive execution.
architecture.upstream_code: Last video/action denoise updates predicted entries; clear_pred_cache then commits real observation followed by real action.
architecture.local: Predicted observation/action entries are separate; commit_executed_feedback atomically clears both then appends real observation and clean executed-action K/V in that order.
architecture.rationale: Both implementations expose the same predicted-to-real state transition; local transactionality additionally prevents partially committed layer state.

architecture.paper: Streaming tokens preserve temporal identity in a finite attention window.
architecture.upstream_code: frame_st_id shifts video/action mesh ids; oldest cache update ids are evicted from a pool sized by attn_window30.
architecture.local: H3 video/audio positions receive an absolute frame offset, ActionDiT receives absolute action offsets, and each layer evicts oldest chronological entries at 15*(32 pooled observation tokens+4 actions per observed frame)=540 tokens.
architecture.rationale: H3 three-axis RoPE and DreamWAM action RoPE differ from Wan's shared mesh, so absolute offsets are preserved within each pretrained coordinate system rather than pretending the coordinates are identical.

data.paper: Long video-action sequences train causal history.
data.upstream_code: LeRobot latent clips pair all historical video/action frames with random causal chunk/window masks.
data.local: Frozen C57 manifest contains 200779 train rows from 1542 episodes. Each row references only s-8..s-56 executed-action chunks and observations every four executed actions; full audit reports zero missing references and zero future leakage.
data.rationale: manifest SHA256 8f95005ac66fd89ca3a22a80d75480e9792b09f976e928f2eb70d4f08680049; maximum 15 observation frames plus 56 executed actions is 536 tokens, below capacity 540.

action.paper: The actually executed actions, not the proposal alone, are written back with observed frames.
action.upstream_code: LIBERO client records an observation every four actions and returns complete executed action chunks before the next prediction.
action.local: C57 rollout session accepts post-execution observation K/V frames and normalized executed actions and fails closed if feedback is missing. Its dedicated feedback wire records only actions actually accepted by env.step, requires observation K/V exactly after actions 4 and 8, and commits before another prediction. A real LIBERO process trace remains pending.
action.rationale: The model-side interface is complete, but a real LIBERO request/response trace is required before declaring deployment equivalence.

objective.field: causal action loss gradient through clean history K/V
objective.paper: Noisy current action attends clean causal history in a joint flow objective.
objective.upstream_code: Four-stream block-causal mask allows current noisy action loss to update shared blocks through clean history.
objective.local: Teacher-forced history and rollout call the identical commit function; current shifted-flow loss backpropagates through clean executed-action K/V projections.
objective.rationale: The local sequential graph implements the same causal dependency without exposing future observation/action targets.

optimization.paper: Post-train the causal world-action model for downstream control.
optimization.upstream_code: LIBERO: eight GPUs, microbatch1, accumulation10, AdamW lr1e-5 betas0.9/0.95 wd0.1, warmup10, 5000 steps, save200.
optimization.local: C57 long5000 completed on eight A800 ranks with microbatch1, accumulation10, AdamW lr1e-5 betas0.9/0.95 wd0.1, warmup10 then constant, save200 and 400000 samples from D0-s14000. This is 1.9922398249 effective epochs over 200779 selected windows.
optimization.rationale: The source-backed budget completed, so insufficient step count is not the accepted explanation for the failed final heldout gate.

evaluation.paper: Long-horizon and generalization success are measured closed loop.
evaluation.upstream_code: LIBERO evaluator runs all tasks and 50 trials with the persistent server/client lifecycle.
evaluation.local: Pre-gate targets Goal and LIBERO-10 with Object regression; full gate uses fresh paired trials, replan8, identical noise and D0 success predicate.
evaluation.rationale: The target benchmark is the project's frozen D0 LIBERO protocol, not a cross-repository headline comparison.

decision.rationale: The complete source-backed 5000-step/400000-sample budget and strict final restore pass, but the preregistered final heldout gate fails both required effect thresholds and is slightly worse than D0. Permission is NO_GO: do not run LIBERO or extend this five-block LingBot port. Preserve its lifecycle lesson only; the next context route starts from the promoted C58 carrier and remains separately gated.
